response.justification: The candidate is a strong generalist engineer with broad full-stack and systems experience, but does not meet the core mandatory requirements: his hands-on C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month role in 2014–2015 plus a thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years on Windows. He has no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a startup investment-formation platform, not capital markets systems), and no evident SQL Server/Oracle depth. His recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js, making him a poor match for a specialized C++ fixed-income consulting role.
strengths: Strong low-latency/performance systems experience (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput services)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, and open-source contributions
Broad polyglot background with good communication skills (workshops, talks, teaching)
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months, over a decade ago) vs. required 5–10 years
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain expertise
Primarily Linux/web stack background; no evident Windows platform or SQL Server/Oracle experience
